items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: He worked with us. Sails worked with us until we got on the boat.

ctx.x: Guitar, no. Did you know Sails? When you were playing music, did you know him very well?
Now he was, Sails was on the boat with us. He was on the boat with us?
Yeah. You mean when Baby Dodge was with you?
